  u16("__0x14", {  }),

  u8("flags", {  }),
  u8("wpn_inv_idx", {  }),
  u8("arm_inv_idx", {  }),
  record("cur_stats", Stats),
  u8("poison_dmg", {  }),

  u16("__0x4A", {  }),

  u32("__0x8C", {  }),

export default definePack({
  name: "Ply Save.Bin",
  endian: "little",
  pointerSize: 8,
  types: [Stats, AbiMap, OverdriveModeCounts, OverdriveModeFlags, Char],
  nodes: {
    "entry": structNode(Char, { label: "Char（入口）" }),
    "Stats": structNode(Stats, { label: "Stats" }),
    "AbiMap": structNode(AbiMap, { label: "AbiMap" }),
    "OverdriveModeCounts": structNode(OverdriveModeCounts, { label: "OverdriveModeCounts" }),
    "OverdriveModeFlags": structNode(OverdriveModeFlags, { label: "OverdriveModeFlags" }),
